items.name: styles
items.title: Tokens & reset
items.description: Shared design tokens (Ref → Sys → Cmp) and CSS reset, with the default brand theme. Install once before any component — every component references only the Cmp tier defined here. tokens.css holds Cmp + the type-role classes; the Ref + Sys values come from the brand file beside it (mango), which applies with no attribute set. Add `brand-<name>` for an alternate theme.

items.name: guide
items.title: Sando guide
items.description: The consumer guide: installing and upgrading Sando, the theme attributes, the rules your own CSS and compositions follow, and which unit to use. Installed with `styles` into `docs/sando/`, so the agent working in your repo can be pointed at it.

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: The design system's icons: one module that every component imports its glyphs from, drawn by the icon library themes/icons.json names (Lucide by default), plus the stylesheet that sets each icon's stroke to the stem of the text beside it. Changing library is that config and a rebuild; no component changes.

items.name: brand-mango
items.title: Mango brand theme
items.description: The mango theme (망고) — a complete alternate look: yellow brand, lime accent, one Outfit face in both text slots, 1px hairlines, a 2px focus ring. It is the default brand, so this item carries the same file `styles` does and applies with no attribute set; it exists so a product whose theme is mango can name it (ADR-0049).

items.name: brand-avocado
items.title: Avocado brand theme
items.description: The avocado theme (아보카도) — a complete alternate look: a green brand (hue 130) with an amber accent held at an absolute angle, a warm tinted neutral, Archivo for text with Figtree for the display roles, and 2px and 4px border chrome. Select it with `data-brand="avocado"` on <html>; with no such attribute the default brand from `styles` renders. Install both — import order does not matter, the cascade is decided by selector specificity.

items.name: brand-lychee
items.title: Lychee brand theme
items.description: The lychee theme (리치), a neutral alternate look: an achromatic charcoal brand over a true-grey paper (neutral chroma 0), with a calm blue accent split off for links, the focus ring and selection (ADR-0023). Type, spacing, radius, motion and the translucent overlay are mango's. Select it with `data-brand="lychee"` on <html>; with no such attribute the default brand from `styles` renders. Install both: import order does not matter, the cascade is decided by selector specificity.

items.name: brand-blueberry
items.title: Blueberry brand theme
items.description: The blueberry theme (블루베리) — a complete alternate look: an indigo brand (hue 291) with a split-complementary amber accent, a true-grey paper (neutral chroma 0), a crisp 4px radius ladder on a 2px grid, 12px spacing base, Inter for text with Inter Tight for the display roles, and a 2px focus ring. Its decorative and functional borders share one value by decision, so cards read at the same weight as inputs. Select it with `data-brand="blueberry"` on <html>; with no such attribute the default brand from `styles` renders. Install both — import order does not matter, the cascade is decided by selector specificity.

items.name: brand-aronia
items.title: Aronia brand theme
items.description: The aronia theme (아로니아): a blue action fill dark enough that white labels clear 5:1, a cool grey paper, 1px hairlines, a radius ladder anchored at 8 with each control's corner following its size, Pretendard for display and body text on a type ladder anchored at 16, and a high-contrast variant. Select it with `data-brand="aronia"` on <html>; with no such attribute the default brand from `styles` renders. Install both — import order does not matter, the cascade is decided by selector specificity.

items.name: link-button
items.title: Link Button
items.description: A link drawn as a Button: it navigates (role link, a real anchor) and reuses Button's classes, variants and sizes.

items.name: countdown
items.title: Countdown
items.description: A live time-left chip: an urgency Badge whose caller-worded text ticks each second, exposed as a timer that is not announced per tick.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A press-driven action trigger. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: A row of related actions. Owns the placement Stack cannot express: a reverse column on a narrow screen so the primary action rises to the top while staying last in the DOM, and an even grid split for centered layouts.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for selecting a date. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A labeled field for picking a date, combining a segmented date input with a Calendar popover. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A disclosure group for expanding titled content panels. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single disclosure section for expanding titled content. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A status message with optional title and icon. No headless primitive; built and owned entirely in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user image with accessible fallback content. No headless primitive; built and owned entirely in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: media
items.title: Media
items.description: A rounded frame that clips one picture, video or artwork to the system's corner. Compose AspectRatio inside it for a ratio.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site Header
items.description: A full-width top bar on the page's fill with an edge below, sticky by default, whose content follows the page grid's frame. Holds a Navbar.

items.name: docked-bar
items.title: Docked Bar
items.description: A full-width bar fixed to the bottom of the viewport, on the page's fill with an edge above, whose content follows the page grid's frame and clears the device's bottom safe area. Holds a BottomNavDocked.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact inline label for status or metadata. No headless primitive; built and owned entirely in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: responsive
items.title: Responsive helper
items.description: Type + helper that expands responsive layout props into breakpoint custom properties. Shared by the layout primitives.

items.name: stack
items.title: Stack
items.description: A layout primitive for 1D flow (row or column) with token-scale gap. Responsive props; arrangement only, owns no look.

items.name: layer
items.title: Layer
items.description: A layout primitive that overlaps its items in one grid cell, each pinned to a side, a corner or the middle, so a badge sits over an image or copy over a banner. Source order is stacking order. Responsive props; arrangement only, owns no look.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: A layout primitive for 2D grids — fixed columns or auto-fit — with token-scale gap. Responsive props; arrangement only, owns no look.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A layout primitive that constrains arbitrary content to a width/height ratio. Arrangement only, owns no look.

items.name: sticky-bar
items.title: Sticky Bar
items.description: A toolbar region pinned to the top of the scrolling page on the page's own fill, edge to edge of its frame, with a hairline under it; its content stays on the page column.

items.name: show
items.title: Show
items.description: A layout primitive that shows its children only from, or only below, a breakpoint step, so one control can sit in two places by width. Arrangement only, owns no look.

items.name: indent
items.title: Indent
items.description: A layout primitive that applies the text inset to the text a Block or consumer places beside a rounded box or on a painted surface: start (default), end or both. Arrangement only, owns no look.

items.name: container
items.title: Container
items.description: A layout primitive that caps content width and centers it, with inline gutters. Responsive props; arrangement only, owns no look.

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login Form
items.description: A ready-to-use sign-in form: email + password fields, submit, and an inline form-level error. Composed from Form, TextField, Button, Alert, and Stack.

items.name: settings-form
items.title: Settings Form
items.description: A sectioned account settings form for profile details and preferences, with submit and form-level error states.

items.name: control-group
items.title: Control Group
items.description: A titled group of controls, spaced so each control reads as its own and the group as one. Composed from Stack.

items.name: profile-form
items.title: Profile Form
items.description: A profile form with an avatar preview, identity fields, submit, and form-level error states.

items.name: address-form
items.title: Address Form
items.description: A structured shipping address form with a responsive city, state, and ZIP row plus country selection.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact Form
items.description: A contact form for name, email, and message with submit and form-level error states.

items.name: signup-form
items.title: Signup Form
items.description: A ready-to-use account creation form: name, email, password, terms acceptance, submit, and an inline form-level error. Composed from Form, TextField, Checkbox, Button, Alert, and Stack.

items.name: forgot-password-form
items.title: Forgot Password Form
items.description: A ready-to-use password-reset request form: email field, submit, and an inline form-level error. Composed from Form, TextField, Button, Alert, and Stack.

items.name: reset-password-form
items.title: Reset Password Form
items.description: A ready-to-use new-password form: password confirmation, submit, and an inline form-level error. Composed from Form, TextField, Button, Alert, and Stack.

items.name: otp-verify-form
items.title: OTP Verify Form
items.description: A ready-to-use email verification form: one-time code field, verify and resend actions, and an inline form-level error. Composed from Form, TextField, Button, Alert, and Stack.

items.name: side-panel
items.title: Side Panel
items.description: A full-height panel for a sidebar: a title, an optional close button and description, and a body that fills the rest of the height; pass a ScrollArea to scroll it. Pair it with AppShell's rail slot, which folds the panel while the rail stays.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: A full-width page heading with optional description, breadcrumbs, and page-level actions. Composed from Breadcrumbs and Stack.

items.name: footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: A full-width site footer with responsive link columns and a bottom copyright row. Composed from Grid, Stack, Link, and Separator.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: A site's global navigation bar: brand, primary destinations with the current page marked and optional dropdowns, a search slot and actions, an optional utility row above it (the two-tier GNB), on a sticky full-width SiteHeader. Collapses to a menu button on small screens.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: An iOS-style single-select control: a track of adjacent segments with a raised pill behind the selected one. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A paged slide viewport with previous/next controls and position dots. Paging is plain React state; the arrow controls compose the Button. Look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: bottom-nav
items.title: Bottom Nav
items.description: A floating iOS-style bottom navigation bar with 3–5 icon+label items and a current-page highlight. Composed from Card, NavItem, and Grid.

items.name: bottom-nav-docked
items.title: Bottom Nav Docked
items.description: A bottom navigation bar docked full-width to the bottom edge, with an edge above and 3–5 icon+label items with a current-page highlight. The docked take of Bottom Nav. Composed from DockedBar, NavItem, and Grid.

items.name: list-controls
items.title: List Controls
items.description: The controls above a result list: a scope Select with its label inside beside a search button, then refine actions (filter, sort) and an optional narrowing toggle. Composed from Select, Button, Switch, and Stack.

items.name: floating-toolbar
items.title: Floating Toolbar
items.description: A control bar pinned to the bottom of the viewport, floating over page content. Composed from Card (raised surface) and Toolbar (roving-focus behaviour); the Block owns only the placement.

items.name: floating-bar
items.title: Floating Bar
items.description: A bar of mixed controls (search, selects, a view switch, actions) pinned to the bottom of the viewport. Unlike Floating Toolbar it has no roving focus, so a text field inside it keeps its arrow keys. Composed from Card and Stack; the Block owns only the placement.

items.name: app-bar
items.title: App Bar
items.description: A mobile/app top navigation bar with a leading back button, centered title, and trailing actions. Composed from Button and Stack.

items.name: action-sheet
items.title: Action Sheet
items.description: An iOS-style action sheet rising from the bottom edge with a list of actions and a cancel control. Composed from Drawer, Button, and Stack.

items.name: navigation-rail
items.title: Navigation Rail
items.description: A compact vertical navigation rail (tablet/desktop) with stacked icon+label destinations and optional header/footer slots. Composed from NavItem and Stack.

items.name: post-card
items.title: Post Card
items.description: A social feed post with author header, body, optional media, and like/comment/share actions. Composed from Card, Avatar, and Button.

items.name: user-menu
items.title: User Menu
items.description: A self-contained account menu opened by an avatar trigger with an optional user name. Composed from Avatar, Button, Menu, and Stack.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A full-height vertical section navigation with labelled groups, icons, a current-page highlight, and collapsible nested nav. Composed from NavItem, Stack, and React Aria Disclosure.

items.name: mobile-nav
items.title: Mobile Nav
items.description: A Drawer-based navigation for compact viewports with a Button trigger and vertical links. Composed from Drawer, Button, Link, and Stack.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: A responsive application skeleton arranging optional sidebar and header slots around semantic main content, with an inset variant that lifts the header and content onto one panel beside the sidebar.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: A reusable confirmation modal with cancel and confirm actions. Composed from Dialog, Button, and Stack.

items.name: form-dialog
items.title: Form Dialog
items.description: A modal form with consumer-supplied fields and cancel and submit actions. Composed from Dialog, Form, Button, and Stack.

items.name: option-sheet
items.title: Option Sheet
items.description: A sheet of single-choice rows that applies the picked option at once and closes: a sort order, a view. A bottom sheet on a phone, a centred panel from the large step.

items.name: drawer-form
items.title: Drawer Form
items.description: A form panel with consumer-supplied fields and cancel and submit actions: a slide-over by default, or with `responsive` a bottom sheet below the large breakpoint and a centred panel above it, kept as one overlay so an open form keeps its values. Composed from Drawer, Form, Button, and Stack.

items.name: quick-filter-rail
items.title: Quick Filter Rail
items.description: A row of round quick-filter shortcuts, each an icon plate over a caption, that scrolls sideways when it outgrows its column. Composed from Button, ScrollArea, and Stack.

items.name: plan-card
items.title: Plan Card
items.description: One offer in a comparison list: provider and rating, the headline spec, specs, tags, the price with its note, a favourite toggle and an optional expandable benefit row. Composed from Card, Badge, Rating, Link, ToggleButton, Collapsible, and Stack.

items.name: price-comparison
items.title: Price Comparison
items.description: A monthly price without and with gifts, then the contract's total cost, on one sunken panel. Composed from Card, Separator, and Stack.

items.name: price-summary
items.title: Price Summary
items.description: A price before and after a discount on a sunken panel, with a line explaining the difference and an optional small action. Composed from Card, Separator, and Stack.

items.name: notification-list
items.title: Notification List
items.description: A vertical list of dismissible in-app notification cards. Composed from Card, Button, and Stack.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A full-width page notice with optional action and dismissal. Composed from Alert, Button, and Stack.

items.name: cookie-consent
items.title: Cookie Consent
items.description: A responsive cookie consent bar with policy link and accept and manage actions. Composed from Button, Link, and Stack.

items.name: payment-form
items.title: Payment Form
items.description: A card payment form with cardholder, card number, expiry, CVC, submit, and form-level error states.

items.name: search-bar
items.title: Search Bar
items.description: A full-width inline search form with an accessible search field and submit action.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: A responsive row of select filters, active-filter tags, and a clear action.

items.name: wizard
items.title: Wizard
items.description: A multi-step flow with a progress indicator, consumer-supplied step content, and back, next, and completion actions.

items.name: stat-card-grid
items.title: Stat Card Grid
items.description: A responsive grid of KPI cards with optional trend badges. Composed from Card, Badge, Grid, and Stack.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A centered empty-collection placeholder with optional icon, description, and consumer-supplied action. Composed from Stack.

items.name: result-state
items.title: Result State
items.description: A centered result or status section with optional code, description, and consumer-supplied actions. Composed from Stack.

items.name: description-list
items.title: Description List
items.description: A responsive semantic list of term and description pairs. Composed from Grid and Stack.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity Feed
items.description: A chronological feed of actor activity with avatars and timestamps. Composed from Avatar and Stack.

items.name: active-session
items.title: Active Session
items.description: A session in progress: one large figure, labelled supporting figures, a live mark and pause and end controls. Composed from Card, Badge, Button, Grid, and Stack.

items.name: route-progress
items.title: Route Progress
items.description: A trip from an origin to a destination, partway done: both endpoints, a progress bar, time remaining and a status. Composed from Card, ProgressBar, Badge, and Stack.

items.name: file-list
items.title: File List
items.description: An uploaded-file list with an optional drop zone, upload progress, and remove actions.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A searchable and paginated data table with a composed empty-state fallback.

items.name: color-swatch
items.title: Color Swatch
items.description: A color preview swatch with alpha checkerboard support. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: color-field
items.title: Color Field
items.description: A labeled field for editing a hex color or individual color channel. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: color-area
items.title: Color Area
items.description: A two-axis color area for adjusting color channels. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: color-slider
items.title: Color Slider
items.description: A channel slider for hue, alpha, or other color values. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: color-wheel
items.title: Color Wheel
items.description: A circular hue control for color selection. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: color-swatch-picker
items.title: Color Swatch Picker
items.description: A selectable set of color swatches. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A triggerable color picker popover composed from color area, slider, field, and swatch controls. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A navigation trail for hierarchical page locations. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A structured content container with header and footer parts. No headless primitive; built and owned entirely in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A labeled control for toggling a boolean value. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal overlay for focused dialog content. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A modal sheet that slides in from a viewport edge. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A navigational text link with standard or quiet styling. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: nav-item
items.title: Nav Item
items.description: A single navigation row (icon + label + optional trailing chevron) that owns the row look — hover fill, current-page highlight, indentation. Renders as a link or a button. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A triggerable popover menu with items and separators. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A labeled numeric input with increment and decrement controls. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: option-group
items.title: OptionGroup
items.description: One option group of a product: its name, a required tag, a rule such as a maximum, and the choices as equal-width chips or as radio or checkbox rows. Owns the group contract: required groups cannot be emptied, choices past the maximum and sold-out choices disable, and on an exclusive optional group a none choice clears it. The name, required tag and rule reach assistive technology.

items.name: payment-method-picker
items.title: PaymentMethodPicker
items.description: The choice of how to pay, where pressing a method acts at once. Methods, labels and order are data; tiles on a wide screen, a list on a narrow one. Arranges ActionTiles in a grid or a stack: each method is its own Button.

items.name: bottom-action-bar
items.title: BottomActionBar
items.description: The action row that closes a customer screen: one full-width forward Button, or an outline secondary and the primary in halves, laid out by ButtonGroup. The last row of a screen column, never floating over content; it keeps the safe area below.

items.name: repeater-field
items.title: RepeaterField
items.description: A field whose value is a list of rows the author adds and removes, such as option names with prices: the caller's fields per row in equal columns, a remove control per row disabled where a row is locked, and an outline add Button. Focus moves into the added row, or into the row that took a removed one's place. Arranges Button and Stack.

items.name: card-prompt
items.title: CardPrompt
items.description: The step that waits for a card: the amount, the keyed prompt for insert, tap, swipe or any, the device's own picture of where to present it, a politely announced notice such as a failed IC read, and an outline cancel. Arranges StepHeader and Button.

items.name: consent-checklist
items.title: ConsentChecklist
items.description: The terms a person agrees to before a step: each with a required or optional tag and a read Button beside it, an agree-all that is mixed while some are checked, and a forward action disabled until every required term is checked, with an optional outline decline.

items.name: keypad-entry
items.title: KeypadEntry
items.description: A step that asks for a number on a keypad: a phone number with a fixed prefix, an amount with its unit, a code, or a PIN shown as dots that submits itself when complete. Arranges StepHeader, a read-only TextField, NumericKeypad and the submit and decline Buttons.

items.name: step-header
items.title: StepHeader
items.description: The header that opens a step screen: an optional eyebrow in the brand ink, the step's title as a heading (a span of it can be stressed with StepHeaderEmphasis), and an optional description. Aligned to the start in a staff panel or centred on a customer screen.

items.name: action-tile
items.title: ActionTile
items.description: A tile that acts when pressed: an icon, a label and an optional second line, the whole tile the press target, vertical in a grid or horizontal in a list. Nothing stays selected, so it is a Button, not a radio card. Renders a react-aria-components Button; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: order-ticket
items.title: OrderTicket
items.description: A kitchen ticket: the order's source, name, tag and elapsed time (tinted once overdue), its lines with options, each a toggle that turns struck and checked when made, an expand Button for long orders, and a footer that completes the order with an optional call action. Renders react-aria-components ToggleButtons; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A one-line notice, with an optional second line, that scrolls sideways only while it overflows: the idle notice on Front and Front kiosk mode. Opaque inverse surface; pressing it pauses (WCAG 2.2.2); reduced motion wraps the text instead of moving it.

items.name: masked-text
items.title: MaskedText
items.description: A personal value shown masked, with an eye Button that asks the consumer to reveal it and one that masks it again. The full value reaches the DOM only once revealed; the masked form is read by a label instead of its asterisks. maskPhone masks a Korean mobile number. Look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: order-line
items.title: OrderLine
items.description: One line of an order: the item's name, its chosen options, any discounts, the price with an optional struck original, and the actions that change it (a quantity stepper, change options, remove). Read-only for a mirror or a payment detail, muted for an earlier round. Selection belongs to the GridList the lines sit in.

items.name: product-tile
items.title: ProductTile
items.description: A product in an order grid. The whole tile is the press target: name and price, or a square photo above them, an owner colour on the start edge, a badge after the price, a sold-out state, and in edit mode a remove control in its corner. ProductTileAdd is the dashed empty position. Renders a react-aria-components Button; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: message-preview
items.title: MessagePreview
items.description: A picture of a message the store will send through another channel, shown beside the form that composes it: a channel band in the caller's channel colour, an optional hero picture and title, the sender, a rule, the message with its line breaks kept, and a closing note. Not interactive; scrolls when long. Look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: A hook that is true while the person asks for reduced motion (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), and on the server. Shared by the units that animate content: Chart and Marquee.

items.name: control-size
items.title: controlSize
items.description: The five sizes a control takes, and the three-size type role each one sets its text in. Shared by every control that takes x-small to x-large.

items.name: resolve-offset
items.title: resolveOffset
items.description: Reads an overlay's stand-off token off the document root as the number of pixels React Aria's offset prop takes. Shared by the overlays that hang off a trigger: Popover and Tooltip.

items.name: use-scroll-clearance
items.title: useScrollClearance
items.description: A hook that keeps focus clear of a bar pinned over the top or bottom edge of the viewport (WCAG 2.4.11), by setting the document's scroll padding on that edge to the bar's reach. Shared by SiteHeader, DockedBar, BottomNav, FloatingBar and FloatingToolbar.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A line, bar or donut chart over categories with its title, a legend and the same data as a table read in its place. Composes Recharts; the look is Cmp tokens passed as custom properties. Colour is never the only cue: line series have their own stroke pattern, slices direct labels.

items.name: time-grid
items.title: TimeGrid
items.description: A day of bookings on a time axis, one column per staff member: hour rows down a gutter, each booking a block tinted by its product colour whose top and height are its start and length, overlapping bookings side by side, and a current-time line. Each booking renders a react-aria-components Button named with its time; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: table-tile
items.title: TableTile
items.description: One table on a floor map, the whole tile the press target. Empty: the name inside an edge in the zone's colour. Seated: filled in that colour with the name, the time since seating, the first items with quantities, how many more, and the total. Renders a react-aria-components Button; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: scan-frame
items.title: ScanFrame
items.description: The overlay that frames a live camera for scanning: a dimmed surround, a clear square, wide or circular window with corner brackets or a ring, and a politely announced caption. The consumer passes the camera feed as children. Look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: SignaturePad
items.description: A drawing surface for a handwritten signature. Strokes are kept in 0-1 coordinates so a paired display can mirror the same signature at another size; a clear button empties it. Behavior owned in React with pointer events on an inline SVG; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: numeric-keypad
items.title: NumericKeypad
items.description: A 3×4 digit keypad for amounts, phone numbers and PINs: digits only, a `00` key for amounts and an empty slot otherwise, delete always bottom-right, left-to-right in every locale. One tab stop; arrow keys move linearly through the keys (Left/Right only, no Up/Down). Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A triggerable floating panel with optional arrow. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A controlled page navigator with previous, next, page, and ellipsis controls. No headless primitive; built and owned entirely in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: progress-circle
items.title: ProgressCircle
items.description: A determinate progress ring, for progress where a bar does not fit. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: A labeled indicator for determinate or indeterminate progress. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: progress-marker
items.title: Progress Marker
items.description: A decorative ring or dot for one stage in a discrete progress sequence. No headless primitive; built and owned entirely in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: progress-connector
items.title: Progress Connector
items.description: A decorative completion line between discrete progress markers. No headless primitive; built and owned entirely in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A labeled group for choosing one radio option. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A star rating: an input built on a radio group, one radio per star, or a read-only picture that can show a fraction. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: pin-field
items.title: Pin Field
items.description: A code entered into separate cells (a one-time code, a PIN): one real text field under cells drawn for the eye, so paste, one-time-code autofill and screen readers work as on any field. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: A labeled search input with a clear control. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: field-button
items.title: FieldButton
items.description: A button that shows the current choice (a label, a value, or both, with an optional count) and a trailing chevron, and opens a sheet, menu or popover. Rectangle or capsule; hugs its content unless isFullWidth.

items.name: step-ladder
items.title: StepLadder
items.description: A sheet of graph paper for placing several things on one numbered scale: the columns are the steps, each row picks one, and its marked cells show where it sits. Each row is a horizontal radio group; behavior borrowed from react-aria-components, look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A labeled picker for selecting one list option. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: list-box
items.title: ListBox
items.description: An always-visible selectable list with optional sections. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: resize-handle
items.title: ResizeHandle
items.description: A draggable edge between two panes that sets the size of one, by pointer or arrow keys (WAI-ARIA window splitter). Look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: spacing-field
items.title: SpacingField
items.description: A box-model editor: an optional margin ring around a padding ring around the element, each side a number or a named option, with a toggle that links the four sides. Behavior borrowed from react-aria-components; look owned in Vanilla CSS.

items.name: band
items.title: Band

items.name: separator

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton

items.name: slider

items.name: spinner

items.name: toast

items.name: switch
